desc:
(IMPORTANT: Development for Parkour Pandemic has paused due to personal reasons. Thank you all for your outstanding support!)

[THIS GAME IS IN BETA EXPECT BUGS]

The Fracture broke the world's clock. Time runs in a loop now, replaying the disasters that ended a hundred worlds. You're a survivor, You don't know how you got here...

This is a fast-paced running game where you survive disasters that tear the map apart around you. Rounds get harder as the clock runs down. Activate beacons to shorten the rounds time
Buy different gear with Volts to give yourself buffs. Like extra speed or even different mechanics.

🎛️ Controls
B - Emote
Q – Dash
C – Slide
Double Space – Double Jump

(Special mechanic controls:)

R – Air Blast (Power Gear)
Space near a wall – Wall Boost (Speed Gear)
Press the dash key again after a dash Q – Power Dash (Power Gear)

🎮 PC • Mobile • Console
🏆 Inspired by the Disaster & Parkour genres & Nullscape
